title: Rav Chisda bar Avdimi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Berakhot 53b: “Come and hear: Rav Chisda bar Avdimi said, ‘The cedars did not overshadow it,’ and Rava said,” etc. Hyman reports the reading R. Yitzchak bar Avdimi in Dikdukei Soferim and compares Shabbat 77b.

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot paragraph reads ארזים, “cedars,” where the supplied notice has ארוים. “Overshadow” conveys the comparison with cedars, not the dimming of a lamp. Chisda versus Yitzchak remains a reported textual variant.

The consulted Berakhot passage names Rav Chisda bar Avdimi, while Shabbat 77b names Rav Yitzchak bar Avdimi in connection with the same verse. The Dikdukei Soferim reading remains as reported by Hyman.
